description: Checks whether an AI assistant with live web search recommends a business when a customer asks for what it offers, without naming it. Returns how many answers named the business, which brands were named instead, which websites the assistant relied on (the sources to be present on), and what the assistant says about the business. Runs in the background on first use (about a minute): if it reports that the test is running, call it again shortly. Free, no account.

url.description: Domain or URL of the site, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com". Use your own site or one you are authorized to review.

name: check_ai_recommendations
title: Check AI recommendations
